selected_evidence.requirement: Create secured opsbot accounts on both systems
selected_evidence.summary: opsbot exists as UID 501 on both nodes with locked passwords and protected SSH directories.
node2 authorized_keys has mode 600, opsbot ownership, and the expected 2048-bit key.

selected_evidence.requirement: Run commands from node1 as opsbot on node2 and require key authentication
selected_evidence.summary: Key-authenticated commands succeed as opsbot UID 501 on both nodes; password-only attempts are rejected with only publickey/GSSAPI offered.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restarts, both nodes report CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5.
